lead.headline: AI-POWERED PARKING TO COVER 12 MAJOR ROADS IN HSR LAYOUT
lead.deck: Bengaluru South City Corporation plans 3,982 paid parking spaces across 18 km of commercial roads, with digital payments and live space monitoring.
paragraphs: A new AI-based smart parking system is planned for 12 major commercial roads in HSR Layout, spanning 18.02 km. The Bengaluru South City Corporation says it is intended to ease congestion and protect footpaths.

The plan provides about 3,355 two-wheeler spaces and more than 627 car spaces. Rates are set at INR 15 per hour for two-wheelers and INR 30 for cars, with AI cameras to show availability and monitor parking.

sidebarStory.headline: CRICKETER YUZVENDRA CHAHAL JOINS BJP OBC MORCHA EXECUTIVE
sidebarStory.subhead: The leg-spinner has been named a special invitee to the party committee.
paragraphs: India leg-spinner Yuzvendra Chahal joined the BJP and was appointed a special invitee to the national executive committee of its OBC Morcha, the party announced Saturday.
Chahal thanked party leaders in a social media post. The BJP also announced a slate of committee appointments from several states, NDTV reported.

groups.ariaLabel: Bengaluru civic, education, worker and public safety news

stories.headline: ASHA WORKERS KEEP FREEDOM PARK PROTEST GOING AFTER TALKS FAIL
paragraphs: Karnataka ASHA workers have continued their day-and-night protest at Bengaluru Freedom Park after rejecting the state government assurance on a pay increase.
The workers are seeking a monthly honorarium of INR 15,000. Their association said the protest had entered its fifth day as of Saturday.

stories.headline: NPS SARJAPUR ROAD ANNOUNCES CAMPUS CLOSURE, SAYS IT HAS FOUND NEW SITE
paragraphs: National Public School Sarjapur Road told parents it would stop operating at its current site after this academic year, citing a dispute with its landlord.
The chairman later told The Times of India that the school had found a nearby location and planned to move its 350 students. Parents said they had not yet received formal details.

stories.headline: 28-YEAR-OLD SCOOTER RIDER KILLED IN KENGERI HIT-AND-RUN
paragraphs: A 28-year-old scooter rider, Mohammed Khasim, died after an unidentified vehicle hit him and fled near Kengeri early Sunday, according to a report carried by BLR Today.
Khasim was returning to his home in Kambipura when he was struck on Ring Road. Residents took him to a nearby hospital, where he died.

groups.ariaLabel: India political, diplomatic and judicial developments

stories.headline: INDIA AND CHINA COMMANDERS HOLD FRESH TALKS TO EASE ARUNACHAL FRONTIER TENSIONS
paragraphs: Indian Army III Corps commander Lt General Girish Kalia met his Chinese counterpart and other officers for talks aimed at calming tensions along the Arunachal Pradesh frontier, The Indian Express reported Sunday.
The meeting is part of efforts to manage local friction along the Line of Actual Control. Both sides have used commander-level talks to address border issues and prevent escalation.

stories.headline: ALL 14 ACCUSED PLEAD NOT GUILTY IN NEET PAPER-LEAK CASE
paragraphs: A Delhi fast-track court formally framed charges against all 14 accused in the NEET-UG 2026 paper-leak case on Saturday. The accused denied the allegations and opted to face trial.
The court directed that prosecution evidence begin on November 25, with proceedings to continue day by day. The cancelled exam had been taken by about 22 lakh candidates.

stories.headline: NEPAL PM BALENDRA SHAH BEGINS FIRST OFFICIAL BILATERAL INDIA VISIT
paragraphs: Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah is due in New Delhi Sunday for his first official bilateral visit to India since taking office. He is scheduled to meet External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar after arriving.
Shah and Prime Minister Narendra Modi are due to hold delegation-level talks Monday, with energy projects and wider economic cooperation on the agenda.

groups.ariaLabel: India public health, public safety and infrastructure news

stories.headline: SUSPECTED SPURIOUS LIQUOR DEATHS RISE TO 16 IN MANIPUR
paragraphs: The death toll in the suspected hooch tragedy in Manipur Chandel district rose to 16 by Saturday, with more than 600 people reported hospitalised after consuming adulterated liquor.
The state has formed a high-level committee to investigate the source and composition of the suspected liquor and the medical circumstances of the deaths. The cause remains under investigation.

stories.headline: HPV VACCINATION DRIVE CROSSES ONE CRORE DOSES IN NINE MONTHS
paragraphs: India has administered more than one crore HPV vaccine doses in less than nine months, reaching about 87 per cent of its annual target cohort of 14-year-old girls, according to the Health Ministry.
Six states have reached full coverage of their identified target populations. Karnataka is among the states reporting coverage above 90 per cent.

stories.headline: NITISH SETU OPENS AS PART OF INR 34,470-CRORE BIHAR PROJECTS
paragraphs: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the six-lane Dargah-Bidupur cable bridge over the Ganga in Bihar on Saturday, naming it Nitish Setu in honour of former chief minister Nitish Kumar.
The 19.7-km bridge links Patna and Vaishali districts. The wider programme included projects worth about INR 34,470 crore across connectivity, energy and public services.

groups.ariaLabel: Indian cricket, hockey and regional diplomacy

stories.headline: PANT HITS 128 AS INDIA STRETCHES LEAD TO 261 IN WELLINGTON TEST
paragraphs: Rishabh Pant scored 128 on Day 4 of the first Test against New Zealand, becoming the first visiting wicketkeeper to score Test hundreds in all SENA countries, The Indian Express reported.
At lunch, India were 629 for six in their first innings, leading by 261. The century was Pant's first Test hundred since returning from injury.

stories.headline: INDIA WOMEN SET TO OPEN BHOPAL CAMPAIGN AGAINST THAILAND
paragraphs: India are scheduled to face Thailand in Bhopal on Sunday in the Women's Asian Champions Trophy, with the hosts looking to add another title to their 2016 and 2023 wins.
The round-robin tournament features six Asian teams. The India-Thailand match is listed for 7 pm local time by Hockey India.

stories.headline: INDIAN TEAM IN DHAKA FOR TALKS AHEAD OF GANGA TREATY EXPIRY
paragraphs: An Indian delegation has reached Dhaka as the two countries prepare for Joint River Commission discussions scheduled for November 22 and 23, The Hindu reported.
The Ganga Water Treaty is due to expire in December. The talks come as India and Bangladesh weigh how to handle the agreement's renewal and future water-sharing arrangements.
